name: Plexa — Multi-Model Fusion Orchestrator
description: Reads AI_Model_Families_Register.csv (26+ model families) and Multimodal_Families_Register.csv at boot. Builds a capability matrix from the registers. Recommends model families for tasks by capability matching. Implements phi-decay confidence weighting for ensemble fusion — no external API calls.
capabilities: recommend(task) — best model family from register by capability match
fuse(outputs, weights?) — phi-decay weighted consensus across multiple outputs
rank(taskType) — ranked model families for a specific capability class
getCapabilityMatrix() — full model capability matrix from all registers
